d:
Embark on a vibrant journey through Havana with me! Stay at the luxurious Gran Muthu Habana, owned by an Indian group. See the stunning sea view from my hotel room.
Encounter the challenges of buying a SIM card and exchanging currency with friendly locals. Explore Havana's streets, noting the vintage cars amidst a backdrop of traffic and occasional pollution. Dive into the heart of the Cuban culture, where people are welcoming and ready to assist.
